integrity: The transfer-operator formula, pressure-zero characterization, monotonicity, and Fourier comparison were checked in the primary source. The new inequality is proved by an exhaustive outward interval enclosure of a twelve-branch positive suboperator on the full unit interval; positivity of the omitted branches transfers the certificate to the infinite operator. The standalone verification program and its exact parameters are included.
scientific_limitations: This is a one-sided certified upper bound for the correlation dimension and the resulting Fourier-decay obstruction. It does not certify the exact correlation dimension, prove the exact Fourier-decay exponent, or provide a matching lower bound. The numerical constant was chosen for a short robust finite certificate rather than claimed optimality.
title: A twelve-branch pressure certificate for the Minkowski correlation dimension
